model.family: CLAPSep (official multimodal-query checkpoint, S1E/S1W-identical, zero-shot init)
model.representation: bounded real magnitude mask (sigmoid) + mixture phase; STFT 1024/320 hann periodic, 32 kHz mono; phase=False (unchanged, per S1a audit; section 41 reserves mask redesign for a future stage)
model.trainable_scope: decoder_model.mask_net + decoder_model.layers.3 + decoder_model.skip.3 + decoder_model.inverse_patch_embed (final separation/mask head + upper decoder layers)
frozen: audio_branch pretrained HTSAT feature encoder including its LoRA adapters (eval, no_grad)
decoder film and skip.0..2 and layers.0..2
decoder spec_norm BatchNorm running state (eval mode = normalization state frozen)
model.student_init: exact frozen zero-shot weights; the S1W adapted checkpoint is a negative artifact and is never loaded

query_policy.condition: FIXED S1E primary: audio query Q1, zero negative embedding

data.domain: AUTHENTIC REAL RAW HANDCAM MIXTURES only (frozen S1W TRAIN identities)
data.train_anchors: 201 high-confidence teacher-anchor windows = 1206 s central region across all 36 TRAIN recordings
data.dev: 39 anchor windows on the 7 frozen DEV identities (evaluation only)
data.views_per_example: canonical context + one of {early, late} context + one known-gain (+-3 dB) canonical view; shared central ~6 s comparison region
data.forbidden: no synthetic target+nuisance remixing, no S1W mixtures, no proxy targets, no generated audio, no test identities

optimization.lr_rationale: protocol section 30: 1e-5..3e-5 band; smaller trainable surface than S1W and catastrophic forgetting is the primary risk; S1W's 1e-4 not defaulted to
optimization.amp: bfloat16 autocast around decoder+loss; STFT/ISTFT float paths as dispatched

loss.teacher_anchor: waveform L1 + 0.5*MR-STFT(256/1024/2048, log10-magnitude L1, floor 1e-5) per view vs frozen teacher central crop; averaged over canonical/context/gain views
loss.consistency_and_scale: waveform L1 + 0.5*MR-STFT between student central crops after known-gain correction
loss.anti_collapse: 6 dB hinge: quadratic penalty when student RMS < teacher RMS - 6 dB on anchors; transient-band floor 4.5 dB on top-20% energy teacher frames (guard only, never rewards loudness)

inference_protocol.training_and_dev_view_chunks: exact 10-s chunks at 32 kHz (trained distribution), official peak-0.9 rescale protocol applied and undone identically to teacher
inference_protocol.full_clip_eval: exact 10-s chunk overlap-add (0.5 hann), applied IDENTICALLY to zero-shot and student (S1W FAILURE_CASES section 2)

checkpoint_selection.rule: DEV-only; section 32 validity: no collapse; no raw passthrough; anchor selectivity preserved; cross-context consistency improves vs zero-shot; no click/friction proxy regression. Components always reported separately.
checkpoint_selection.anti_collapse_gate: section 33 DEV gate before any TEST/SEALED evaluation: collapse_rate_12db == 0, median student/teacher ratio in a defensible band, no widespread >12 dB suppression, no widespread passthrough

environment.parity: bitwise (max|delta| = 0.0) vs S1E stored zero-shot output, logs/00_parity_check.json
